record.title: Two ankle blocks in two foot through-pockets on an R16.3 cradle — a 0.1000 mm-per-side location pair, screw-retained (nothing snaps)

joins.a: the ankle's two +y blocks (part:microduck-ankle-left / -right, interface 'foot_blocks'): x 34.1000..39.1000 and 60.9000..65.9000 (5.0000 mm each), each a pair of 1.5000 mm ribs at y 31.6630..33.1630 and 34.1630..35.6630 with a 1.0000 mm gap, envelope 4.0000 mm; heights 6.0610 mm (inner rib) and 8.0000 mm (outer rib) from z -21.3420
joins.b: the foot's two through-pockets (part:microduck-foot-left / -right, interface 'ankle_cradle'): x 34.0000..39.2000 and 60.8000..66.0000 (5.2000 mm each), y 31.5630..35.7630 (4.2000 mm), open top to bottom in z; and with them the R16.3 cylindrical seat on the x 32.9000..34.1500 / 65.8500..67.1000 ledges that the ankle's R16.3018-16.3058 under-hull lands on

record.dof_left_why: Two rectangular spigots 26.8000 mm apart in a pair of matching pockets remove every rotation and both cross-axis translations; the cylindrical cradle takes the third. Nothing is left free — but nothing is HELD either: see detachable. The joint locates; the screw retains.
record.detachable_why: It falls apart in the hand. The pockets are open top to bottom in z (measured: no material at all along z at five stations inside them), the blocks are prismatic with no undercut, and the fit is a 0.1000 mm per-side CLEARANCE. What holds the foot on is the single M2 at (x 50.0000, y 4.5020) on connection:threaded-m2 — remove it and the foot lifts straight off.
record.standard_why: A pair of printed rectangular spigots in printed pockets is governed by no published standard. ISO 286 grades round fits; quoting it for a 5.0000 x 4.0000 mm prismatic block would be borrowing authority the geometry does not have. compat.py grades the measured clearances directly and refuses everything else by name.
record.adds_parts_why: Nothing is consumed. The M2 that actually retains the joint is added by connection:threaded-m2 on its own joint row; naming it here as well would double-count it in assembly:microduck's BOM.
record.why: THE FIT IS MEASURED ON BOTH SIDES WITH THE SAME INSTRUMENT AND IT IS 0.1000 mm PER SIDE, EXACTLY. Blocks (ankle_left.stl, cecad.meshfeatures.intervals): x 34.1000..39.1000 and 60.9000..65.9000, both 5.0000 mm and constant across y 31.8..35.5; ribs y 31.6630..33.1630 and 34.1630..35.6630 (1.5000 mm each, 1.0000 mm gap), envelope 4.0000 mm; heights 6.0610 and 8.0000 mm from z -21.3420. Pockets (foot_left.stl, same instrument): x 34.0000..39.2000 and 60.8000..66.0000, both 5.2000 mm, y 31.5630..35.7630 = 4.2000 mm, closed at y 31.4 and 35.8, and OPEN top to bottom in z at all five stations probed. 5.2000 - 5.0000 = 0.2000 in x and 4.2000 - 4.0000 = 0.2000 in y: 0.1000 mm per side on both axes. The cradle that carries the load with them is measured too: the ankle's under-hull circle-fits to R16.3058 (residual mean 0.00432) at x 40 and R16.3018 (0.00396) at x 60, about a centre 0.007-0.011 mm from the declared ankle axis (y 22.0000, z -6.2230). ONE THING IS MEASURED AND CONTRADICTS THE SLUG, and it is recorded rather than smoothed: NOTHING SNAPS. No undercut, barb, lip or lead-in exists on either side; a through-pocket has no lip for a barb to pass; and a 0.1000 mm clearance cannot snap into anything. The joint is a two-spigot location pair on a cylinder, retained by the single M2 at (x 50.0000, y 4.5020) through connection:threaded-m2. compat.py carries `claims_a_snap` as the permanent guard. What stays CANNOT DETERMINE is stated per-check: the as-printed clearance (0.1000 mm is one FDM extrusion width — whether a real pair slides or binds is a print question nobody has measured) and the load share between the two end ledges and the R16.5 relief band.

joint.default_state: the foot lifted onto the ankle from below: both blocks down their pockets, the ankle's R16.3 hull on the foot's two end ledges, M2 driven

axes_cannot_determine.tz: locked ONLY once the M2 is driven. The pockets are through in z and the blocks carry no undercut, so before the screw this axis is entirely free -- the foot drops off. Stated here because 'locked' would otherwise read as geometry doing work it does not do.

engagement.block_spacing_why: 60.9000 - 34.1000: the two spigots are 26.8000 mm apart, which is what makes the pair an anti-rotation feature rather than a single peg

rating.retention_why: MISSING BY DESIGN, not by omission: this joint transmits shear and carries no axial retention at all. The retention belongs to connection:threaded-m2 and its M2 pilot, and it is that folder's number to state.

joint.why: holds_by form: the blocks locate by shape in shear, with 0.1000 mm of slack per side. transmits shear only -- the pockets are open in z, so nothing here resists lift-off. driven false: the ankle is driven by its XL330 through `ankle_horn` at x 64.7000; this joint is downstream of it.
